verdict.rationale: Remote-desktop SaaS products handle user session data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question and the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only the CLI, the REST API and portal management. It contains no AI-training policy, opt-out setting, or data-use commitment, so there is no evidence AnyDesk delivers this.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
